# Matching LLVM sources supply the test utilities absent from its archive.
foreach(tool FileCheck count not)
  if(NOT TARGET ${tool})
    if(tool STREQUAL "FileCheck")
      add_llvm_utility(FileCheck FileCheck/FileCheck.cpp)
      target_link_libraries(FileCheck PRIVATE LLVMFileCheck LLVMSupport)
    elseif(tool STREQUAL "count")
      add_llvm_utility(count count/count.c)
    else()
      add_llvm_utility(not not/not.cpp)
      target_link_libraries(not PRIVATE LLVMSupport)
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()
